PNAS requires a 'Significance Statement' (50-120 words, written for non-specialists, required for all Research Reports and Stage 2 Registered Reports) IN ADDITION TO the 250-word Abstract — the current PublisherProfile schema has no dedicated slot for a second abstract-like field, so this is recorded here rather than encoded; do not conflate it with abstractWordLimit, which refers only to the Abstract itself.

PNAS's distinctive Results-before-Methods section order is a structural feature the checker/exporter should respect rather than normalize to the more common Methods-before-Results ordering used by most other journals in this profile set.
